tut_2:
In this short tutorial i will show
you how to use the app...
tut_4:
On the top screen you will see a
poststamp with the info about
your package.
tut_6:
The date of the latest status update
of your package
tut_7:
The parcel locker name or the
sender's name
tut_8:
And the approximate destination
address of your package
tut_9:
Using the D-Pad you can navigate
between the packages shown on
the bottom screen
tut_10:
When you press (A) on any package,
you will be taken to its
details menu.
tut_11:
On the top screen you will see a
preview of the current parcel locker.
tut_12:
And on the bottom screen, a menu with
tracking details and a (QR) button
tut_13:
When you touch it, you will be taken to
the package pickup menu.
tut_14:
On the bottom screen, a QR code for pickup
will be displayed using scanners available
in the parcel lockers
tut_15:
Which... don't like working with the
3DS's screen
tut_16:
Alongside the button to remotely
open the locker!
tut_17:
After touching it you will get a pop-up
confirming that you really want to
open the locker
tut_18:
Its only there to prevent you from
accidentally opening the parcel locker.
tut_19:
InPost3DS doesn't detect your location
so be careful plz.
tut_20: That would be all for the tutorial.
tut_21:
Thanks for using InPost3DS!
I hope you will enjoy using it. :)
